newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products down, but gas oil premiums hold.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products down, but gas oil premiums hold.

text.p: NWE oil products all weakened on Thursday, largely the result of continued futures losses, dealers said.

Gasoline barges were down $1/$2 a tonne, Eurograde offered at $231/$232. Regular was steady at around $224. However, the market was slow to begin after an industry function on Wednesday evening in London.

Gas oil fell further, falling IPE futures taking about $3 off prices. Traders said supply of heating oil and diesel, particularly of stored material, looked set to increase, but premiums held up as futures gave way.
Refinery heating oil was offered at IPE Nov +$4 fob ARA. Diesel offers stayed above +$30.
High sulphur fuel oil was down $2/$3 a tonne, following crude losses. Refinery product traded early at $125 fob ARA, but dropped a further $2 a tonne later to $123.
Stored fuel oil subsequently traded at $123.50 and $123.75.
Later offers were at $124 for stored material and $125 for refinery product. Bunker enquiries were said promising.
